record.question: At what source-published mileage does each named Chickenfoot and Gem spur leave the Little Lakes mainline?
record.reason: Official sources establish the spur identities and lengths, but the spur and mainline features do not share exact endpoints and no source publishes their mileage positions along the unsplit 3.104216-mile mainline. The graph therefore preserves branches_from context without proximity-snapping a traversable junction.
